<function name="Rename" parent="file" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Attempts to rename a file with the given name to another given name.

This function is constrained to the `data/` folder.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="orignalFileName" type="string">The original file or folder name. See <page>file.Write</page> for details on filename restrictions when writing to files.

**This argument will be forced lowercase.**</arg>
		<arg name="targetFileName" type="string">The target file or folder name. See <page>file.Write</page> for details on filename restrictions when writing to files.

**This argument will be forced lowercase.**</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">`true` on success, `false` otherwise.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
